newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-EARLY RISER LONARD SHARES HALFWAY LEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-EARLY RISER LONARD SHARES HALFWAY LEAD.

text.p: overcame a pre-dawn wake-up call on Friday to take a share of
the lead on six-under-par 138 in the Australian PGA
At the end of a long day Lonard shared the lead with
compatriots Justin Cooper and Chris Gray.
Lonard was one of 53 players forced to rise early to
complete their first rounds after strong winds disrupted
Thursday's opening round at the New South Wales Golf Club.
Lonard, one of the first out on the course, finished his
round on three-under 69. He then birdied four of the first five
holes of his second round to briefly hold the outright lead
before dropping a shot to finish equal with Cooper and Gray.
Cooper holed a birdie putt at the par four 18th to complete
a second round 68 while Gray carded a steady 70.
American Jerry Kelly's 66 was the best round of the day and
he joined overnight leader Wayne Riley of Australia on 139.
